note: Companions are found by NAME BASIS in the same folder, from stored paths only -- no file is opened. A pattern enters this list only with a cited basis (R12 section 11.1; R8 section 13: safely identifiable relationships only). Takeout .json, Apple .aae and video .thm are EXCLUDED: their naming was not verified (open question O-5). Document companions (an HTML page and its _files folder, CAD references) are not attempted (open question O-4).

raw_extensions.basis: The product's own raw_image file family (Phase3.registry.FILE_FAMILIES), i.e. the camera RAW formats RawImageAnalysis reads; Adobe Camera Raw keeps a sidecar beside a RAW file that cannot hold metadata itself (source S27). DNG is included although a DNG can embed its settings: a sidecar beside one is still a sidecar.

patterns.primary: a camera RAW file in the same folder with the same stem (name without its last extension), compared through path_key
patterns.ambiguous_when: two or more non-sidecar files in the folder share that stem (RAW + JPEG): the sidecar may belong to either, so it is never guessed (companions_travel_together is unknown for every primary that shares it)
patterns.basis: Adobe Camera Raw settings: the sidecar has the same base name plus .xmp, and must be renamed, moved and deleted together with the raw file (https://helpx.adobe.com/in/camera-raw/desktop/get-started/overview-and-setup/camera-raw-settings.html; R12 source S27)

patterns.primary: the file <name>.<ext> in the same folder
patterns.basis: darktable user manual, sidecar files: sidecars are named <basename>.<extension>.xmp (https://docs.darktable.org/usermanual/development/en/overview/sidecar-files/sidecar/; R12 source S28)

patterns.primary: the file <name>.<ext> in the same folder -- unless a file named <name>_<n>.<ext> exists, in which case the sidecar is that file's own darktable_xmp
patterns.basis: darktable user manual, sidecar files: duplicates are named <basename>_<n>.<extension>.xmp (R12 source S28)
